with_replacement: uniform valid contiguous nonwrapping starting point for each drawn block
without_replacement: chronologically partition history into random-length contiguous blocks; shuffle blocks; use every row once; repartition and reshuffle after complete history cycle
final_partition_block: truncate to history end if remaining rows are shorter than minimum
portfolio_policy: fixed target weights restored at each common observed endpoint, matching unchanged panel construction
reference_selection: Higher (worse) canonical main score of the two configurations on identical successful coverage; final choice after both complete
testfolio_approximation: Joint asset block resampling and within-path portfolio accounting. Public block bounds are configurable. This frozen support-bounded profile is not a claim to reproduce their one-to-five-year UI defaults or unpublished RNG/start-index code.
